nodes.label: 3-Layer API Architecture (Schema -> Handler -> Route)
nodes.rationale: Separates validation, pure DB logic and HTTP concerns; handlers return data/booleans and the API route decides status codes.

nodes.label: Check vs Action Handler Separation
nodes.rationale: Check functions (checkCanUserAddAccount) gate requests; action functions (addAccountForUser) mutate, keeping logic granular and testable.

nodes.label: Numeric Input Handling (v-model.number + z.coerce.number + numeric(10,2))
nodes.rationale: JSON serialization can turn numbers into strings; coercion keeps types consistent, and numeric columns avoid float errors for money.

nodes.label: Structured API Response Format {statusCode, statusMessage, message, data}
nodes.norm_label: structured api response format {statuscode, statusmessage, message, data}

nodes.label: Drizzle Kit Migration Workflow
nodes.rationale: Never edit migrations manually; use db:generate / db:push.

nodes.label: Keep Supabase Active Workflow
nodes.rationale: Pings /api/health every 6 days (safer than 7) so the hosted Supabase database does not pause from inactivity.

nodes.label: ZAddAccountSchema initial_balance coercion fix
nodes.rationale: Form input for initial_balance could arrive as a string and fail strict z.number(); switched to z.coerce.number() plus v-model.number.

nodes.label: Handlers Must Not Throw HTTP Errors
nodes.rationale: Let the API route decide the response code; handlers only do DB work and return data or booleans.
nodes.norm_label: handlers must not throw http errors

nodes.label: Bug: Initial balance as transaction overlaps categories
nodes.norm_label: bug: initial balance as transaction overlaps categories

nodes.label: Read-only Demo User
nodes.rationale: Lets visitors tour the app with sample data (1 Dec 2025 - 15 Jan 2026) while server rejects writes with 403.

nodes.norm_label: cursor-based transaction pagination (20 per page, infinite scroll)

nodes.label: Initial Balance Stored on Account (not a transaction)
nodes.rationale: Initial balance is a column on the account and included in balance, not recorded as a transaction.
nodes.norm_label: initial balance stored on account (not a transaction)

nodes.label: Database Conventions (numeric money, UUID PKs, cascade deletes)
nodes.rationale: numeric(precision, scale) avoids float rounding for money; cascades remove user data on account deletion.
nodes.norm_label: database conventions (numeric money, uuid pks, cascade deletes)
